SELECT

    (session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'ip_reputation_score')::float as vpn_ratio,

    + 0.3 * COALESCE((session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::float, 0) / 10.0 
    + 0.3 * (session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::float / 20.0 as tei
FROM security_sessions LIMIT 5;

WITH tei_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        acct_gate,
        0.4 * (session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'ip_reputation_score')::float 
        + 0.3 * COALESCE((session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::float, 0) / 10.0 
        + 0.3 * (session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::float / 20.0 as tei
    FROM security_sessions
)
SELECT 
    acct_gate,
    tei,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY tei) as bucket_num
FROM tei_calc
ORDER BY tei
LIMIT 10;
